subject: Consolidated monthly bundle vs portal push — billing owner & file layout
messages:
From: Maria Costa <maria.costa@starlight.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Starlight AP <ap@starlight.co>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Invoice delivery preference & per-entity PDFs

Hi Soojin,

We're getting our AP run ready for September and want to confirm how Redwood can deliver invoices for our multiple legal entities in the EU. Two items:

1) We need separate PDF invoices for each legal entity (different VAT numbers) but we'd prefer them bundled as one monthly package (zip or single PDF with bookmarks) rather than 20 individual emails.
2) We also need a single remittance CSV that lists invoice numbers, entity code, net/gross, VAT amount, and bank details to ingest into our payables system.

Questions: can Redwood push a monthly bundle to a portal (preferred) and additionally send a single summary email with a download link? Or do you only support per-invoice email delivery? Also, will the invoice file include the VAT evidence tag and entity tax ids in metadata?

We attached a sample of the format we ingest (starlight_remittance_template.csv). Can you share a sample Redwood invoice PDF for our format review?

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Costa
Head of AP, Starlight Health
Attachments: starlight_remittance_template.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Costa <maria.costa@starlight.co>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference & per-entity PDFs

Hi Maria — great question, thanks for the clear template. Short answer: we can support both patterns; trade-offs below and a recommended plan.

Option A — Portal bundle (recommended):
- Monthly push: one zipped package containing a PDF per invoice (file-named by invoice number + entity code) plus a single remittance CSV.
- Benefits: single push, fewer emails, easy for AP to download and archive.
- Requirements: we need the entity mapping (entity code -> VAT/Company reg) and the field mapping you use for PO/invoice matching.

Option B — Per-invoice email:
- Sends a separate email for each invoice with the PDF attached and an invoice metadata header in the message body.
- Benefits: immediate delivery and easier for teams that rely on email ingestion.
- Downsides: high volume for large accounts, more likely to trigger mail server limits.

Hybrid we often use: portal push as primary + summary email to AP listing included invoices and a download URL. We can also enable an SFTP drop if you prefer an automated pull.

VAT/evidence: each invoice PDF will include the tax id for the issuing legal entity and a VAT evidence tag in the invoice metadata. We can also add a separate CSV column with VAT_evidence_url if you want a link to supporting docs.

Next steps I need from you:
- Confirm preferred delivery: portal-bundle + summary email (yes/no) or portal only.
- Provide the entity mapping spreadsheet (column: entity_code, legal_name, vat_number, remit_bank_bic) — we can accept a Drive link or the attached mapping template.
- Confirm PO matching logic: do you match on PO number only, or do you use PO + entity_code?

I'll loop in Connor for SFTP/drop options and Karthik for any corner cases with multi-entity consolidation. Happy to set a 30-min call if you prefer.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: invoice-field-mapping-v1.xlsx

From: Maria Costa <maria.costa@starlight.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Starlight AP <ap@starlight.co>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:24:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference & per-entity PDFs

Thanks Soojin — portal bundle + summary email is our preferred route. A few clarifications:

- We will match on PO number + entity_code. Some invoices come without a PO and those should be flagged in the CSV.
- Remittance CSV columns we need: invoice_number, invoice_date, entity_code, legal_name, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, bank_account, currency, po_number, invoice_pdf_name, vat_number.
- We also need the invoice PDF to expose the legal entity VAT number in both the visible header and as an embedded metadata field (machine-readable).

Attached is a small sample invoice PDF (starlight_invoice_sample.pdf) and our remittance template. Can Redwood produce a single zip named STARI_INV_YYYYMM.zip with individual PDFs and a remittance CSV inside? If so, we'd like a pilot for September invoices (first draft delivered Oct 5).

Thanks — Maria
Attachments: starlight_invoice_sample.pdf, starlight_remittance_template.csv

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Costa <maria.costa@starlight.co>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:00:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference & per-entity PDFs

Hi Maria —Connor here (finance ops). Implementation notes and proposed pilot: 

1) We can generate STARI_INV_YYYYMM.zip containing:
   - invoice_YYYYMMDD_INV12345_ENTITYA.pdf (one PDF per invoice)
   - remittance_STARI_YYYYMM.csv (your columns)

2) Delivery options we can configure for you:
   - Portal: automatic monthly push to a secure download folder + pre-signed link (recommended).
   - SFTP: nightly drop of the monthly bundle if you want pull-based ingestion.
   - Email: we can also send a single notification email with the pre-signed link and summary CSV inline.

3) PO matching: we'll add a "PO_missing" flag column in the remittance CSV for records without PO numbers so your system can quarantine them.

4) VAT evidence: we can emit a VAT_evidence_url column if you upload evidence into our secure doc store; otherwise we'll populate vat_number + a boolean VAT_evidence_attached column.

Pilot plan (timeline):
- Sep 01–20: Redwood sets up entity mapping + test bundle generation.
- Sep 21–28: test bundle delivered to your sandbox (via portal link).
- Oct 05: go-live draft bundle for production review.

Acceptance criteria for pilot:
- Zip contains separate PDFs named by invoice number + entity code.
- Remittance CSV columns match your template exactly.
- Summary email arrives within 1 business day of bundle push.

I'll create the HubSpot ticket and share the Drive mapping folder (link below). If SFTP is preferred, let me know host/credential format.

Connor O'Brien
Revenue Operations — Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-invoice-mapping, HubSpot ticket HS-7890

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Costa <maria.costa@starlight.co>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference & per-entity PDFs — next steps

Thanks all — confirming the pilot and next steps:

1) Delivery: portal bundle + summary email. Connor will provision a sandbox folder and deliver a test bundle by Sep 21.
2) Mapping: Maria to drop the entity mapping into the Drive folder by Sep 3 (columns: entity_code, legal_name, vat_number, remit_bank_bic, preferred_contact).
3) PO matching: Redwood will add PO_missing flag; Maria to confirm quarantine workflow.
4) Pilot go-live: draft production bundle on Oct 05.

Soojin (billing owner) will own the go/no-go decision after the Sep 21 test. Connor — please add the SFTP option to the HubSpot ticket (HS-7890) as a fallback. Maria — once you upload the mapping, we'll schedule a 30-min test run.

I'll follow up by EOD with the mutual action plan and the list of fields we'll include in the PDF metadata.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual-action-plan-starlight-v1.docx
